subject: general
question: Who among the following is the author of the book 'The Third Pillar: How Markets and The State Leave the Community Behind'?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Raghuram Rajan__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Raghuram Rajan is the author of the book "The Third Pillar: How Markets and The State Leave the Community Behind".**
 
• This book is a reflection on the **present state of our world seen through the prism of the triad of markets, state, and community, constituting the three pillars of society as it were.**
 
• Raghuram Rajan was the **Chief Economist of the International Monetary Fund Between 2003 and 2006.**
 
• He was an Indian economist and 23rd Governor of the RBI and also the author of the book '**I Do What I Do'**.
